summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed on public preview for SpatialStability patch. Most requested flows pass, but a critical deep-link framing regression remains reproducible for Legacy/Footer from initial state.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct deep-link from initial load can render active chapter in minimized (~0.18 scale) card state instead of full viewport framing, while HUD still shows chapter as active.

integration_issues.issue: Hash route and HUD state can become visually desynced from effective chapter framing until another route transition is performed.

action_items: Fix initial deep-link activation so active Legacy/Footer always expands to full viewport on first transition.
Investigate style/state race around SpatialStability transforms (scale/content-visibility/contain) during first hash navigation.
Retest all chapter deep links from fresh load after fix (especially #route-legacy and #route-footer).
critical_code_review_comments: SpatialStability baseline rule uses aggressive transform/content-visibility containment on all chapters; this appears to allow first-route visual desync in some activation paths.
Continuous navigation and chapter-scoped controls (timeline/gallery/quotes/victories) are otherwise stable in this run.
No horizontal overflow and no page error selectors were observed in desktop/mobile smoke checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary pass: all requested interactions passed (menu/hash links, timeline arrows+keyboard, wheel gating on timeline, gallery next/prev, quote next/prev, victory year filter, mobile smoke). Follow-up diagnostic reproduced a deterministic edge case: from fresh load, direct route-legacy (and route-footer) may remain card-sized (~350x203 at 1920x1080) even with active-node class and matching HUD label; navigating to another chapter and back restores full viewport framing.
rca of the issue: Repro: fresh page load -> directly deep-link to #route-legacy or #route-footer via hash/__spatialGo immediate. Observed: HUD shows correct active chapter, but chapter bounding box remains minimized (~0.18 scale). If user navigates to another chapter (e.g., victories) and back, framing corrects to full viewport. Likely RCA: first-route style/state race between active-node class application and SpatialStability baseline transform/content-visibility containment. Mitigation: force deterministic first activation style recalculation for active chapter and verify transform override wins on first hash transition.
